note: National Reserve Bank of Tonga. Searched for NRBT annual reports and financial statements and for the National Reserve Bank of Tonga Act on PacLII. No NRBT annual report or financial statements PDF surfaced in search, so no independent auditor's report page could be read. PacLII returns only amendment acts (nrbota2007359, nrbota2011359, nrbota2014359, nrbota2017359), not a consolidated audit section, and none of the search snippets named an auditing firm or the Tonga Auditor General as the bank's statutory auditor. No readable source names the auditor.

Kiribati has no central bank and issues no currency of its own (it uses the Australian dollar); no central bank financial statements or statutory auditor provision exists to record. Nothing in search returned a Kiribati monetary authority with audited accounts.
Tuvalu has no central bank and uses the Australian dollar. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.
Nauru has no central bank and uses the Australian dollar. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

The Federated States of Micronesia has no central bank; it uses the US dollar and its banking regulator is the FSM Banking Board. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

The Marshall Islands has no central bank; it uses the US dollar and supervision sits with the Marshall Islands Banking Commission. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.
Palau has no central bank; it uses the US dollar and supervision sits with the Financial Institutions Commission. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

Anguilla is a member territory of the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank and has no monetary authority or central bank financial statements of its own. The ECCB's own external auditor is already recorded; nothing separate for Anguilla was found.
Antigua and Barbuda is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.
Dominica is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.
Grenada is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.
Saint Lucia is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.
Montserrat is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is an ECCB member territory with no separate monetary authority or central bank financial statements; no separate audit arrangement was found.

Centrale Bank van Curacao en Sint Maarten. Searched for CBCS annual reports and financial statements and read the bank's own 'Condensed financial statements as of December 31, 2020' page at exch.centralbank.cw: it sets out the accounting principles used and names no external auditor, no audit firm, no auditor's report, no city and no report date. Press coverage of the 2022, 2023 and 2024 annual reports gave profit figures but no auditor. No readable source names the auditor.

Andorra has no central bank; it uses the euro under a monetary agreement with the EU and its financial supervisor is the Andorran Financial Authority (AFA), not a central bank. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

Monaco has no central bank; it uses the euro under a monetary agreement with the EU and banking supervision is carried out by French authorities. No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

Banca Centrale della Repubblica di San Marino. Two searches for the bank's bilancio and its relazione della societa di revisione returned only the accounts of San Marino's commercial banks (Banca Agricola Commerciale, Banca di San Marino) and pages of the Consiglio Grande e Generale; no BCSM financial statements or audit report page from bcsm.sm surfaced and nothing read named the central bank's external auditor.

Liechtenstein has no central bank; it uses the Swiss franc under its currency treaty with Switzerland and supervision sits with the Financial Market Authority (FMA). No central bank financial statements or external auditor exists to record.

National Bank of Cambodia. Read the NBC Annual Report 2022 (English) hosted on Open Development Cambodia at offset: the document, 200,796 characters of extracted text, covers 2022 operations, the banking system, payment systems, the 2023 outlook and statistical appendices, and carries no independent auditor's report and no auditor's signature block. Searches for separately published NBC audited financial statements returned only Cambodian commercial banks' reports. No readable source names the auditor.

Bank of the Lao PDR. Searched for BOL annual reports and financial statements with an independent auditor's report; every result returned was a Lao commercial bank (BCEL, JDB, BFL-BRED, Booyoung, ICBC Vientiane, Maybank Laos), not the central bank. No BOL financial statements or auditor's report was found to read. No readable source names the auditor.

Brunei Darussalam Central Bank. Read two BDCB publication PDFs under cms.bdcb.gov.bn. The BDCB Annual Report 2025 (publication 17824568929284490.pdf, 308,182 characters of extracted text) lists 'Independent Auditor's Report' at pages FS 5 to FS 9 in its contents, but those pages carry no extractable text: the document jumps from the Report of the Board (FS 1 to FS 4) straight to the Statement of Financial Position (FS 10), with the notes to the consolidated financial statements following to FS 52. Reads at offsets 0, 170000 and 200000 all confirmed the gap. A second BDCB PDF (17758095948258330.pdf, 66,915 characters) contains only Financial Intelligence Unit material and no auditor's report. The firm name is present only as an image, so no readable source names it.

Central Bank of Turkmenistan. No search was able to surface any Central Bank of Turkmenistan annual report, financial statements or auditor's report; the bank publishes no audited accounts that search returned, and no statute text naming an external auditor was found. No readable source names the auditor.

National Bank of the Republic of Belarus. Searched for NBRB annual reports and audited financial statements with an independent auditor's report; every result returned was a Belarusian commercial bank (Paritetbank, Belveb, RRB, MTBank, TC Bank) or an unrelated IMF country report. No NBRB auditor's report page was found to read and nothing named the audit organisation. No readable source names the auditor.
